title: Counting Bits
summary: For each integer from 0 through n, return the number of its 1 bits.

contractDetails.constraints: 0 ≤ n ≤ 100000. Count bits in each nonnegative 32-bit word.

statement: For each integer from 0 through n, return the number of its 1 bits. Output index i holds the count for i.

examples.explanation: The count for 4 drops to one.

constraints: 0 ≤ n ≤ 100000. Count bits in each nonnegative 32-bit word.
hints: Conceptual: Zero has no set bits.
Directional: Right-shifting removes just the low bit.
Implementation: Use the result at floor(i/2), then add i modulo two.
complexityAnalysis: O(n+1) time and O(n+1) output space.
